messages:
emma.finance: FYI escalate — APAC customer raised a failed payment because they require local-currency invoice (SGD) with a PO on the invoice. Their payer entity paid from EUR and the gateway declined due to PO and amount mismatch. invoice: INV-2026-9876 amount: EUR 1,234.56 (expected SGD 1,862.12) :grimace:
sanju-support: ugh. do we have a copy of the original invoice metadata we sent? did we set the billing_entity to APAC or to the EU parent?
liam-sales: customer says their APAC finance team won't accept EUR invoices — they need SGD with local tax breakdown and PO # visible on PDF. otherwise they can't process the payment.
olivia-accounting: pulling invoice now. looks like billing_entity was set to "redwood-eu" and currency EUR. invoice-bot: Generated invoice PDF INV-2026-9876 for billing_entity=redwood-eu currency=EUR amount=1234.56 tax=0.00 po_field=""
emma.finance: gateway response from client: 402 CARD_DECLINED (amount_mismatch) plus their APAC AP acct flagged PO missing. they attempted to pay with corporate card tied to APAC entity — gateway rejected because currency didn't match expected settlement currency.
maya-ops: can we reissue an invoice in SGD quickly AND ensure our payment link maps to their APAC entity? any automation to do that without manual recon?
olivia-accounting: we can reissue a local-currency invoice but need FX conversion policy: do we use live FX at invoice creation or the original EUR invoice amount converted with our rounding rules? currently platform rounds to 2 decimals after converting with rate*amount. that caused a 0.02 SGD diff last month — customer cares about exact PO reconciliation.
raj-legal: also flag VAT: APAC subsidiary requested local tax line items. depending on SG requirements, even if tax=0 we need a VAT/Tax line and a local tax registration number included. so PDF template must include tax_registration_id for singapore entity.
sanju-support: repro steps from client side:
1) customer receives EUR invoice PDF (no PO field)
2) APAC finance uploads to their AP system expecting SGD — reconciliation fails
3) they try to pay via our hosted link which pre-fills EUR amount -> gateway compares card entity currency -> decline with code: AMOUNT_CURRENCY_MISMATCH
4) they call support and will not accept refund -> want reissue in SGD with PO present

emma.finance: can someone run a quick audit: which customers hit this in the last 30 days? need to know if this is a single-case or systemic because our billing_entity mapping logic may be wrong for customers with multiple legal entities.
maya-ops: I'll run a query on invoice records where customer_has_multi_entity=true AND invoice_po_field IS NULL AND currency != customer_primary_local_currency. ETA 30m.
invoice-bot: Query started by maya-ops: SELECT count(*) FROM invoices WHERE multi_entity = true AND po_field = '' AND currency != local_currency AND created_at > '2026-10-01' ; returning sample rows: 4 affected customers.
liam-sales: noted — those 4 include 2 APAC accounts. both requested local invoices in last 60d.
olivia-accounting: Proposed fix options:
- Fast path: reissue SGD invoices for the 2 APAC customers, include PO field and tax_registration_id, mark original invoice as replaced. Manually trigger payment link update.
- Medium path: patch invoice generation to populate po_field from account metadata when present and to choose currency based on customer.billing_preference or entity override. Deploy to staging in 2 days, prod in 7 days.
- Long term: add per-customer billing_entity mapping UI in Console so sales/finops can set preferred invoice entity/currency.

emma.finance: customer is asking for same-day reissue. please do fast path for INV-2026-9876 and email the APAC finance contact once done. Sanju — can you own comms?
sanju-support: on it. olivia — pls reissue and attach corrected PDF. include snippet in email showing FX conversion we used:```
Original EUR: 1234.56
FX rate used: 1.50892
Converted SGD (unrounded): 1862.1226752
Rounded SGD (2dp): 1862.12
PO: ABC-PO-4499
Tax reg: SG-12345678
```
olivia-accounting: reissue done. new invoice INV-2026-9876-SGD created, currency=SGD, amount=1862.12, po_field="ABC-PO-4499", tax_registration_id="SG-12345678". Payment link updated. attached PDF sent to customer.
invoice-bot: Invoice INV-2026-9876-SGD status=issued payment_link=https://pay.redwood.test/inv/INV-2026-9876-SGD
liam-sales: customer reply: "Thanks — our APAC team accepted the PDF and will retry payment. Please confirm settlement currency equals SGD so our AP system matches." :thumbsup:
emma.finance: thanks team. next steps:
- maya-ops to surface count and logs of similar incidents (in 24h)
- olivia to open a ticket to patch invoice generator to fill po_field from account metadata when present (priority P1)
- product to scope Console billing_entity mapping (emma will sync with product)

raj-legal: please ensure copies of both invoices are stored for compliance with multi-entity audit trail. include who authorized reissue.

sanju-support: will send final closure note once payment clears. tracking: case# FIN-7621 :white_check_mark:
